treatment "rowinputs.ztt"{
	background{
		table globals{
		}
		table subjects{
		}
		table summary{
		}
		table contracts{
		}
		table clients{
		}
		table treatments{
		}
		table sessionglobals{
		}
		table participations{
		}
		table offers{
			lifetime = PERIOD;
			execute = WITHEACH;
		}
		table settings{
			lifetime = TREATMENT;
			execute = WITHEACH;
		}
		numsubjects = 2;
		numgroups = 1;
		numpracticeperiods = 0;
		numactualperiods = 2;
		exchangerate = 1;
		startendowment = 0;
		showupfee = 0;
		noAutoscope = FALSE;
		firstBoxesOnTop = FALSE;
		showupfeeawaytext = "Losses: use the show-up fee?";
		showupfeeawayyestext = "Yes";
		showupfeeawaynotext = "No";
		moneyawaytext = "Losses: go on?";
		moneyawayyestext = "Yes";
		moneyawaynotext = "No";
		bancruptwaittext = "Please wait.";
		program{
			table = globals;
			do{
				Rate = 3;
				Markets = 2;
			}
		}
		program{
			table = offers;
			condition = FALSE;
			do{
				Fresh = 1;
				array Units[\Markets];
			}
		}
		program{
			table = offers;
			do{
				Fresh = 7;
			}
		}
		screen action{
			usesbg = TRUE;
			withalertscreen = FALSE;
			noalertscreen = FALSE;
			headerbox "Header"{
				hasframe = TRUE;
				height = 10%;
				top = 0p;
				cuttop = TRUE;
				showPeriods = TRUE;
				showNumPeriods = TRUE;
				periodtext = "Round";
				periodoftext = "of";
				practiceperiodprefix = "Practice ";
				showtime = TRUE;
				timestr = "Seconds left:";
				pleasedecidetext = "Time is up.";
			}
		}
		screen wait{
			usesbg = TRUE;
			withalertscreen = FALSE;
			noalertscreen = FALSE;
			standardbox "Wait"{
				hasframe = TRUE;
				buttonposition = BOTTOMRIGHT;
				buttonsequence = HORIZONTAL;
				item{
					label = "Please wait.";
				}
			}
		}
	}
	stage "Market"{
		startwaitforall = FALSE;
		startConditionStr = "";
		singleentry = FALSE;
		singleentrycontinuation = FALSE;
		timeouttype = always;
		timeout = 60;
		program{
			table = subjects;
			do{
				for(m, \Markets){
					offers.new{
						Market = :m;
						Units[:m] = :m * 10;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		screen action{
			usesbg = FALSE;
			withalertscreen = FALSE;
			noalertscreen = FALSE;
			selectcontractbox "Offers"{
				hasframe = TRUE;
				width = 40%;
				cutleft = TRUE;
				buttonposition = BOTTOMRIGHT;
				buttonsequence = HORIZONTAL;
				table = offers;
				condition = Market == 1;
				sortfields = "-Price; Market";
				ownervariable = Seller;
				item{
					label = "Price";
					variable = Price;
					format = "0.1";
					input = FALSE;
				}
				item{
					label = "How many";
					variable = Qty;
					format = "1";
					input = TRUE;
					showdefault = FALSE;
					emptyallowed = FALSE;
					min = 1;
					max = 5;
				}
				button "Take"{
					clearinputafterok = FALSE;
					norecordmadeorselected = FALSE;
					terminatestage = FALSE;
					donotterminatestage = TRUE;
					specialbuttoncolor = FALSE;
					buttoncolor = 0;
					checker{
						condition = Seller != :Subject;
						message = "Not your own.";
						yesButtonStr = "";
						noButtonStr = "OK";
					}
					program{
						table = offers;
						do{
							Buyer = :Subject;
							Taken = Qty;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			plotbox "Plot"{
				hasframe = FALSE;
				cutbottom = TRUE;
				height = 50%;
				xleft = 0;
				xright = 10;
				ybottom = 0;
				ytop = 10;
				maintainaspectratio = TRUE;
				plotline ""{
					x1 = 1;
					y1 = 1;
					x2 = 9;
					y2 = 1;
					arrowsize1 = 0;
					arrowsize2 = 4;
					arrowwidth = 2;
					linecolor = rgb(1,0,0);
					linewidth = 2;
					arrowclosed = TRUE;
				}
				plottext ""{
					text = "corner";
					x = 10;
					y = 10;
					horizontalalignment = RIGHT;
					verticalalignment = TOP;
					textcolor = rgb(0,0,0);
				}
				plotgraph ""{
					table = offers;
					condition = Market == 2;
					filltoxaxis = FALSE;
					connecttopreviouspoint = FALSE;
					plotpoint ""{
						x = Market;
						y = Price;
						size = 4;
						numedges = 4;
						startat = 45;
						isstar = FALSE;
						linecolor = rgb(0,0,0);
						linewidth = 1;
						fillcolor = rgb(0,0,1);
						plotinput ""{
							displaycondition = Market > 0;
							event = LEFTCLICK;
							key = " ";
							action = DRAG;
							table = offers;
							xvariable = dx;
							yvariable = dy;
							dragsnapx0 = fromx;
							dragsnapy0 = fromy;
							dragsnapx = tox;
							dragsnapy = toy;
							leavestage = FALSE;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			standardbox "Leave"{
				hasframe = TRUE;
				buttonposition = BOTTOMRIGHT;
				buttonsequence = HORIZONTAL;
				button "Done"{
					clearinputafterok = FALSE;
					norecordmadeorselected = FALSE;
					terminatestage = TRUE;
					donotterminatestage = FALSE;
					specialbuttoncolor = FALSE;
					buttoncolor = 0;
				}
			}
		}
		screen wait{
			usesbg = TRUE;
			withalertscreen = FALSE;
			noalertscreen = FALSE;
		}
	}
	stage "Settings"{
		startwaitforall = TRUE;
		startConditionStr = "";
		singleentry = FALSE;
		singleentrycontinuation = FALSE;
		timeouttype = never;
		timeout = -1;
		screen action{
			usesbg = TRUE;
			withalertscreen = FALSE;
			noalertscreen = FALSE;
			standardbox "Enter"{
				hasframe = TRUE;
				buttonposition = BOTTOMRIGHT;
				buttonsequence = HORIZONTAL;
				item{
					label = "Rate";
					variable = MyRate;
					format = "1";
					input = TRUE;
					showdefault = FALSE;
					emptyallowed = FALSE;
					min = 0;
					max = \Rate * 2;
				}
				button "OK"{
					clearinputafterok = FALSE;
					norecordmadeorselected = FALSE;
					terminatestage = FALSE;
					donotterminatestage = FALSE;
					specialbuttoncolor = FALSE;
					buttoncolor = 0;
				}
			}
		}
		screen wait{
			usesbg = TRUE;
			withalertscreen = FALSE;
			noalertscreen = FALSE;
		}
	}
	roles{
		role "S 1"{
		}
		role "S 2"{
		}
	}
	period "1"{
		prompt = "";
		subject 1{
			name = "s";
			group = 1;
			do{
				Type = 1;
			}
		}
		subject 2{
			name = "b";
			group = 1;
			do{
				Type = 2;
			}
		}
	}
	period "2"{
		prompt = "";
		subject 1{
			name = "";
			group = 1;
		}
		subject 2{
			name = "";
			group = 2;
		}
	}
}
